+import base64
+import binascii
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Optional
+from urllib import error, request
+
+
+AWS_KMS_HOST = "kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SignOrVerifyResult:
+    algorithm: str
+    key_id: str
+    message_digest_b64: str
+    signature_b64: Optional[str]
+    verified: Optional[bool]
+    provider: str = "aws-kms"
+
+
+def _b64encode(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
+
+
+def _b64decode(data: str) -> bytes:
+    return base64.b64decode(data.encode("ascii"))
+
+
+def _sha256(data: bytes) -> bytes:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
+
+
+def _kms_request(action: str, payload: dict[str, Any], region: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    region = region or os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
+    host = f"kms.{region}.amazonaws.com"
+    req = request.Request(
+        f"https://{host}/",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        method="POST",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Type": "application/x-amz-json-1.1",
+            "X-Amz-Target": f"TrentService.{action}",
+        },
+    )
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+            return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except error.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(f"AWS KMS {action} failed: {exc.code} {body}") from exc
+
+
+def sign_payload(key_id: str, message: bytes, region: Optional[str] = None) -> SignOrVerifyResult:
+    digest = _sha256(message)
+    response = _kms_request(
+        "Sign",
+        {
+            "KeyId": key_id,
+            "Message": _b64encode(digest),
+            "MessageType": "DIGEST",
+            "SigningAlgorithm": "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256",
+        },
+        region=region,
+    )
+    return SignOrVerifyResult(
+        algorithm=response.get("SigningAlgorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+        key_id=response.get("KeyId", key_id),
+        message_digest_b64=_b64encode(digest),
+        signature_b64=_b64encode(_b64decode(response["Signature"])),
+        verified=None,
+    )
+
+
+def verify_payload(key_id: str, message: bytes, signature_b64: str, region: Optional[str] = None) -> SignOrVerifyResult:
+    digest = _sha256(message)
+    response = _kms_request(
+        "Verify",
+        {
+            "KeyId": key_id,
+            "Message": _b64encode(digest),
+            "MessageType": "DIGEST",
+            "Signature": signature_b64,
+            "SigningAlgorithm": "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256",
+        },
+        region=region,
+    )
+    return SignOrVerifyResult(
+        algorithm=response.get("SigningAlgorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+        key_id=response.get("KeyId", key_id),
+        message_digest_b64=_b64encode(digest),
+        signature_b64=signature_b64,
+        verified=bool(response.get("SignatureValid", False)),
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--key-id", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--message", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--verify-signature", default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--region", default=None)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    message = args.message.encode("utf-8")
+    if args.verify_signature:
+        result = verify_payload(args.key_id, message, args.verify_signature, region=args.region)
+    else:
+        result = sign_payload(args.key_id, message, region=args.region)
+    print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, sort_keys=True))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
+
+try:
+    from aws_encryption_sdk import CommitmentPolicy, EncryptionSDKClient
+    from aws_encryption_sdk.keyrings.aws_kms import AwsKmsKeyring
+except Exception:
+    EncryptionSDKClient = None
+    CommitmentPolicy = None
+    AwsKmsKeyring = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class EnvelopeEncryptionResult:
+    ciphertext: str
+    encrypted_data_key: str
+    key_id: str
+    provider: str = "aws-kms"
+
+
+def _build_keyring(kms_key_id: str):
+    if AwsKmsKeyring is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("aws-encryption-sdk is required for AWS KMS envelope encryption")
+    return AwsKmsKeyring(generator_key_id=kms_key_id)
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(plaintext: str, kms_key_id: Optional[str] = None, aad: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> EnvelopeEncryptionResult:
+    kms_key_id = kms_key_id or os.environ.get("AWS_KMS_KEY_ID")
+    if not kms_key_id:
+        raise ValueError("kms_key_id or AWS_KMS_KEY_ID is required")
+
+    if EncryptionSDKClient is not None and AwsKmsKeyring is not None:
+        client = EncryptionSDKClient(commitment_policy=CommitmentPolicy.REQUIRE_ENCRYPT_REQUIRE_DECRYPT)
+        keyring = _build_keyring(kms_key_id)
+        encryption_context = {k: str(v) for k, v in (aad or {}).items()}
+        ciphertext, header = client.encrypt(source=plaintext.encode("utf-8"), keyring=keyring, encryption_context=encryption_context)
+        encrypted_data_key = base64.b64encode(header.encrypted_data_keys[0].encrypted_data_key).decode("utf-8") if header.encrypted_data_keys else ""
+        return EnvelopeEncryptionResult(
+            ciphertext=base64.b64encode(ciphertext).decode("utf-8"),
+            encrypted_data_key=encrypted_data_key,
+            key_id=kms_key_id,
+        )
+
+    raise RuntimeError("AWS Encryption SDK is not installed")
+
+
+def _aesgcm_encrypt(key: bytes, plaintext: bytes, aad: Optional[bytes] = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    aesgcm = AESGCM(key)
+    nonce = os.urandom(12)
+    ct = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, plaintext, aad)
+    return {
+        "nonce": base64.b64encode(nonce).decode("utf-8"),
+        "ciphertext": base64.b64encode(ct).decode("utf-8"),
+    }
+
+
+def encrypt_payload_with_data_key(data_key_b64: str, plaintext: str, aad: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data_key = base64.b64decode(data_key_b64)
+    aad_bytes = json.dumps(aad or {}, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8") if aad else None
+    return _aesgcm_encrypt(data_key, plaintext.encode("utf-8"), aad_bytes)
+
*** End Patch
